quote: For action graph parsing, we calculate the labeled edge F 1 score (LF 1 ) as the metric to select the best model on the development set. For pseudo-continuous constituency parsing, we use the continuous constituency F 1 score as the metric to select the best model on the development set. For overall results, we use official discodop to calculate continuous F 1 score and discontinuous F 1 score (DF 1 ).
